item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Former NBA player ejected from WNBA game after confrontation with Chicago player
item.description: Former NBA center Enes Kanter Freedom was ejected from Sunday night's Indiana-Chicago WNBA game after he was confronted by Sky guard Natasha Cloud late in the third quarter.
